description:
About the Job:

👋 I’m Emily, the Director of Accounting at Ashby. I am thrilled to be hiring our second Senior Accountant to join our team! I joined Ashby two and a half years ago and have built out the Accounting team in that time. My favorite thing about Ashby is how collaborative we are and how Accounting truly feels like a partnership here.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Senior Accountant to support day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and the month-end close process. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and thrives in a dynamic environment focused on long-term impact and timely execution.

As we complete our first financial audit, migrate to a new ERP, build out our internal controls and open new subsidiaries this role offers strong growth potential. You’ll play a key role in audit readiness, process improvement, and helping the team tighten close and reporting timelines. We’re seeking someone who embraces change and brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset to evolving our accounting practices.

Note: We review all applications, and there isn’t a benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look at the application questions and please submit before the application deadline! We aren’t able to take calls outside of the interview process, so please do not reach out to the team or Emily directly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and approve credit card transactions and expense reimbursements

  • Own Accounts Payable for your first four months in order to learn our vendors and systems, then stay on as a primary backup and escalation point.

  • Prepare and record payroll journal entries for all entities from the payroll register, and reconcile payroll activity to the general ledger as part of the month-end close

  • Own various parts of the month-end and year-end close processes, including Prepaids and Accruals

  • Assist with fluctuation analysis for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end periods

  • Support financial audits by preparing schedules and providing documentation

  • Help design, document, and maintain internal controls and accounting policies as we build out our control environment

  • Support the accounting for international subsidiaries including intercompany activity

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand the accounting impact of new products and help build the processes to support them

  • Perform ad hoc accounting projects as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance

  • 2+ years of general ledger accounting experience, owning close areas like accruals, prepaids, payroll entries and reconciliations

  • Strong understanding of GAAP

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Bonus: Next Gen ERP experience (Rillet) and prior audit support experience a plus

You should apply if:

  • You are solutions-oriented. You balance creative problem-solving with strong operational follow-through.

  • You follow variances through to the answer. You don’t just flag what looks off. You dig in to find the cause, explain it, and correct it when it turns out to be a mistake.

  • You are detail-oriented. Accuracy and precision are critical in this role.

  • You are adaptable. You embrace continuous learning and actively apply new insights to improve your work.

  • You are a team player. You're willing to step into new areas — like Billing — when the team needs support, and you see cross-functional coverage as an opportunity, not an inconvenience.

  • You have experience with consolidations, intercompany activity and FX (this is a plus but not a requirement).

Why you shouldn’t apply:

  • You thrive with heavy day-to-day guidance. We're a supportive team and questions are always welcome, but we're looking for someone who takes ownership, digs in when they hit a new challenge, and brings solutions to the table — not just problems.

  • You prefer an in-office environment. This is a remote role and is best-suited for self-starters who excel in an independent setting.

  • You prefer the predictability of working in an accounting firm. We are a rapidly growing team and company, and the ability to stay flexible and thrive amid change is key to success here. Every day involves new challenges and this role will need to adapt to learning new skills.

  • You prefer a narrowly defined role. Our team is small and coverage matters, you may be asked to support Billing or other functions when teammates are out, and flexibility is essential.

  • You only have public accounting experience. This role is best-suited for someone who understands the day-to-day operations and challenges of working inside a growing company.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough, we assess if you are the right fit for Ashby and we will provide ample information for you to determine if Ashby is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows

  • 30min initial screening with Recruiting

  • 45 min Hiring Manager Interview with Emily

  • Practical Assessment

  • 3, 30 min virtual onsites with various team members as well as 10 min for closing questions with Emily

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby, do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution, regardless of your contribution.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
